builds.name: Krampus
builds.desc: With proper ally/summoner support, the arena buff, hones, fortifies, etc. Dorcas can easily reach over 50 Def and can peak in the 60's. H. Dorcas also has the single highest Atk in the game at 41 and can deal significant damage to most if not all units.

builds.name: Mixed Phase Budget
builds.desc:
So this is a set for the people that don't want to sacrifice too much good fodder, but still want a mixed phase Dorcas. Without Bold Fighter or Vengeful, it is a little less investment. This set requires at minimum one 4* Subaki, one 4* A!Tiki, one 4* Olivia or F!Corrin, and one 3* Raven. The other options include more investment, sacrificing 2 5* units, but giving a more powerful approach. For choosing A slot skills, it depends on your preference, if you want more enemy or player phase oriented. B slot is QR 2, or 3 for more investment, but better enemy phase. The C slot, as always, is your choice, however, I like Hone Atk on almost any unit because it will help anyone, no matter the team. For seals, again, preference, but I prefer either of the 2 above seals, because they can help in player and enemy phase respectively. Stay scary!
Justin/Justthebomb
